occurrence_sentence: NASA Deputy Administrator Pam Melroy has announced that the space agency is utilizing quantum-based technologies, such as sensing, to enhance the study of space and climate change.

According to a [story published in Nextgov/FCW](https://www.nextgov.com/emerging-tech/2023/09/nasa-probes-quantum-tech-sensing-applications/390806/), a platform which aims to spearhead the national dialogue on how technology is revolutionizing the manner in which government agencies serve citizens and execute crucial functions, NASA Deputy Administrator [Pam Melroy](https://www.nasa.gov/people/nasa-deputy-administrator-pam-melroy/) has announced that the space agency is utilizing quantum-based technologies, such as sensing, to enhance the study of space and climate change.
